function noodle(g, pts, tone) {
  const trace = (ox, oy) => {
    g.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
      const x = pts[i][0], y = pts[i][1], p = P(x, y, moundZ(x, y));
      i ? g.lineTo(p[0] + ox, p[1] + oy) : g.moveTo(p[0] + ox, p[1] + oy);

  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(112,60,14,0.9)'; g.lineWidth = 0.035; trace(0.001, 0.005); g.stroke();
  g.strokeStyle = mixRGB([232, 188, 104], [246, 214, 138], tone); g.lineWidth = 0.026; trace(0, 0); g.stroke();
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,242,196,0.8)'; g.lineWidth = 0.009; trace(-0.003, -0.0055); g.stroke();
}

function drawNoodles(g, r) {
  const strands = makeStrands(r, 30, MOUND[0], MOUND[1], 0.09, 0.36, 0.14);
  // a combed fold laid across the top of the nest
  const ang = -0.42, bc = Math.cos(ang), bs = Math.sin(ang);
  for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
    const off = (j - 3.5) * 0.031, ph = r() * TAU, pts = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= 110; k++) {

  for (const s of strands) noodle(g, s.pts, s.tone);
}

function noriSheet(g, r, ax, ay, bx, by, h, lean) {

    g.quadraticCurveTo(lerp(p1[0], p2[0], 0.5) + 0.014, lerp(p1[1], p2[1], 0.5), p2[0], p2[1]);

  g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p0[0], p0[1]);
  g.quadraticCurveTo(lerp(p3[0], p0[0], 0.5) - 0.012, lerp(p3[1], p0[1], 0.5), p3[0], p3[1]);

function tofu(g, r, x, y, w, d, h, rot) {
  const c = Math.cos(rot), s = Math.sin(rot);
  const pts = [[-w / 2, -d / 2], [w / 2, -d / 2], [w / 2, d / 2], [-w / 2, d / 2]].map(([lx, ly]) => [x + lx * c - ly * s, y + lx * s + ly * c]);
  const zt = SURF + h, zb = SURF - 0.004;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {                                       // the faces turned toward us
    const j = (i + 1) % 4;
    const nx = (pts[i][0] + pts[j][0]) / 2 - x, ny = (pts[i][1] + pts[j][1]) / 2 - y;
    if (ny <= 0) continue;
    const a = P(pts[i][0], pts[i][1], zt), b = P(pts[j][0], pts[j][1], zt), c2 = P(pts[j][0], pts[j][1], zb), d2 = P(pts[i][0], pts[i][1], zb);
    const lit = clamp(0.58 - nx / Math.hypot(nx, ny) * 0.3, 0, 1);
    g.save();
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); g.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); g.lineTo(c2[0], c2[1]); g.lineTo(d2[0], d2[1]); g.closePath(); g.clip();
    const top = Math.min(a[1], b[1]), bot = Math.max(c2[1], d2[1]);

    gr.addColorStop(0.16, mixRGB([170, 130, 78], [248, 232, 196], lit));
    gr.addColorStop(0.62, mixRGB([150, 108, 60], [236, 212, 164], lit));
    gr.addColorStop(1, mixRGB([150, 84, 30], [214, 146, 66], lit));
    g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(-2, -2, 4, 4);
    for (let k = 0; k < 26; k++) {                                    // curd pores
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(120,80,36,${(0.08 + r() * 0.14).toFixed(3)})`;
      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(lerp(Math.min(a[0], b[0]), Math.max(a[0], b[0]), r()), lerp(top, bot, r()), 0.002 + r() * 0.004, 0.0015 + r() * 0.002, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();

  g.beginPath(); g.rect(-w / 2, -d / 2, w, d); g.clip();

  g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(-w, -d, 2 * w, 2 * d);
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(126,64,18,0.62)'; g.lineWidth = 0.02; g.lineCap = 'butt';
  for (let k = -2; k <= 2; k++) {                                     // grill marks
    const o = k * w * 0.3 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.01;
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(o - w * 0.5, -d * 0.62); g.lineTo(o + w * 0.5, d * 0.62); g.stroke();
  }
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,84,26,0.5)'; g.lineWidth = 0.03; g.strokeRect(-w / 2, -d / 2, w, d);
  gr = g.createLinearGradient(-w / 2, -d / 2, w / 2, d / 2);          // glaze catching light
  gr.addColorStop(0.1, 'rgba(255,250,230,0.34)'); gr.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,250,230,0)');
  g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(-w, -d, 2 * w, 2 * d);
  g.restore();
  // crisp upper edges
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,244,214,0.55)'; g.lineWidth = 0.004;
  g.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const p = P(pts[i][0], pts[i][1], zt); i ? g.lineTo(p[0], p[1]) : g.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); }
  g.closePath(); g.stroke();
}

function shiitake(g, x, y, rad, rot) {
  const p = P(x, y, SURF), sx = p[0], sy = p[1];
  const h = rad * 0.62, ryTop = Math.hypot(rad * K, h * KZ), ax = sx, ay = sy - h * KZ;
  g.save();
  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(sx, sy, rad, ryTop, 0, PI, TAU); g.ellipse(sx, sy, rad, rad * K, 0, 0, PI); g.closePath();
  g.clip();
  let gr = g.createRadialGradient(ax - rad * 0.28, ay - rad * 0.12, rad * 0.04, sx, sy - h * 0.2, rad * 1.18);
  gr.addColorStop(0, '#9a6a3e'); gr.addColorStop(0.3, '#6a4020'); gr.addColorStop(0.7, '#3b1f0d'); gr.addColorStop(1, '#1d0e05');
  g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(sx - rad - 0.05, sy - ryTop - 0.05, 2 * rad + 0.1, ryTop + rad * K + 0.1);
  // rolled, paler margin
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(206,160,104,0.42)'; g.lineWidth = rad * 0.11;
  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(sx, sy, rad * 0.97, rad * K * 0.95, 0, 0.1 * PI, 0.9 * PI); g.stroke();
  g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,8,2,0.45)'; g.lineWidth = rad * 0.07;
  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(sx, sy, rad, rad * K, 0, 0.05 * PI, 0.95 * PI); g.stroke();

  const dome = (dx, dy) => { const q = Math.min(1, (dx * dx + dy * dy) / (rad * rad)); return [sx + dx, sy + dy * K - h * Math.sqrt(1 - q) * KZ]; };
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const a = rot + i * PI / 3, ca = Math.cos(a), sa = Math.sin(a), len = rad * 0.6, wd = rad * 0.085, up = [], dn = [], mid = [];
    for (let k = 0; k <= 16; k++) {
      const u = k / 16 * 2 - 1, wv = wd * (1 - u * u), cxp = ca * u * len, cyp = sa * u * len;
      up.push(dome(cxp - sa * wv, cyp + ca * wv)); dn.push(dome(cxp + sa * wv, cyp - ca * wv)); mid.push(dome(cxp, cyp));
    }
    g.beginPath(); up.forEach((q, k) => (k ? g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : g.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
    for (let k = dn.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) g.lineTo(dn[k][0], dn[k][1]);
    g.closePath(); g.fillStyle = '#f1e2bd'; g.fill();
    g.beginPath(); mid.forEach((q, k) => (k ? g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : g.moveTo(q[0], q[1])));
    for (let k = dn.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) g.lineTo(dn[k][0], dn[k][1]);

    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,18,6,0.5)'; g.lineWidth = 0.003;
    g.beginPath(); up.forEach((q, k) => (k ? g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]) : g.moveTo(q[0], q[1]))); g.stroke();
  }

  g.save(); g.translate(ax - rad * 0.36, ay - rad * 0.02); g.rotate(-0.5); g.scale(rad * 0.4, rad * 0.14);
  gr = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1);
  gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,238,210,0.5)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,238,210,0)');
  g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(-1, -1, 2, 2); g.restore();
  g.restore();
}

function bokChoy(g, r, x, y, rot) {
  const leaves = [[-0.40, 0.50, 0.090], [0.37, 0.48, 0.085], [-0.02, 0.57, 0.098]];
  const pass = (z, flat) => {
    for (const [fan, Ln, wide] of leaves) {

      // blade
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0.34 * Ln, 0);
      g.bezierCurveTo(0.40 * Ln, -wide * 0.95, 0.70 * Ln, -wide * 1.3, 0.90 * Ln, -wide * 0.64);
      g.bezierCurveTo(1.03 * Ln, -wide * 0.22, 1.03 * Ln, wide * 0.22, 0.90 * Ln, wide * 0.64);
      g.bezierCurveTo(0.70 * Ln, wide * 1.3, 0.40 * Ln, wide * 0.95, 0.34 * Ln, 0);
      if (flat) { g.fillStyle = '#0c2a10'; g.fill(); }
      else {
        let gr = g.createLinearGradient(0.34 * Ln, -wide, Ln, wide);
        gr.addColorStop(0, '#4c9f41'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, '#2f7a31'); gr.addColorStop(1, '#1b4f21');

        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,40,14,0.55)'; g.lineWidth = 0.006; g.stroke();
        g.save(); g.clip();
        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(198,232,160,0.34)'; g.lineWidth = 0.0045;
        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {                                 // veins
          const vx = (0.42 + k * 0.085) * Ln;
          for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {

            g.quadraticCurveTo(vx + 0.05 * Ln, sgn * wide * 0.5, vx + 0.14 * Ln, sgn * wide * 1.2); g.stroke();

const steam = { parts: [], emit: [], c: null, g: null, px: 1, x0: -2.0, y0: -2.9, x1: 2.0, y1: 0.75 };
const MAX_STEAM = 1500;
{

  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) steam.emit.push({ seed: 10 + r() * 90, acc: r(), rate: 15 + r() * 10 });
}
function emitterPos(e, t) {
  const a = e.seed * 2.4 + noise(e.seed, t * 0.06, 0) * 5;
  const rr = clamp(0.08 + Math.abs(noise(e.seed + 31.7, t * 0.05, 1.3)) * 1.25, 0, 0.74);
  return [Math.cos(a) * rr, Math.sin(a) * rr * K + BY];
}
function spawnSteam(x, y, vx, vy) {
  if (steam.parts.length >= MAX_STEAM) return;
  steam.parts.push({ x, y, vx, vy, age: 0, life: 3.4 + rnd() * 2.8, s: rnd(), size: 0.045 + rnd() * 0.04 });
}

const ptr = { x: 0, y: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, on: false, k: 0, ux: 0, uy: 0, over: false, lrx: 9, lry: 9 };
const light = { x: 0, y: 0 };
const par = { x: 0, y: 0 };
let time = 0, flick = 1, reduced = false;

function stepSteam(dt, t) {
  const parts = steam.parts;
  for (const e of steam.emit) {
    const strength = smooth(-0.3, 0.35, noise(e.seed * 3.1, t * 0.16, 5.5));
    e.acc += dt * e.rate * strength;
    if (e.acc >= 1) {
      const p = emitterPos(e, t);
      while (e.acc >= 1) { e.acc -= 1; spawnSteam(p[0] + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.035, p[1] + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.02, 0, 0); }
    }
  }
  const f = 1.15, e = 0.03, scroll = t * 0.22, push = ptr.k > 0.02;
  const relax = Math.min(1, dt * 9), damp = Math.exp(-dt * 1.3);
  for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = parts[i];
    p.age += dt;
    if (p.age >= p.life || p.y < steam.y0 - 0.2) { parts[i] = parts[parts.length - 1]; parts.pop(); continue; }
    const hgt = BY - p.y, nz = t * 0.1 + p.s * 0.06;
    const nx0 = p.x * f, ny0 = p.y * f + scroll;
    const n0 = noise(nx0, ny0, nz), n1 = noise(nx0 + e, ny0, nz), n2 = noise(nx0, ny0 + e, nz);
    const turb = 0.045 + 0.15 * smooth(0, 1.3, hgt);
    const rise = -(0.17 + 0.10 * p.s) * (1 - 0.35 * smooth(0.7, 2.4, hgt));
    const pull = -p.x * 0.10 * (1 - smooth(0.15, 1.0, hgt));
    if (push) {
      const dx = p.x - ptr.ux, dy = p.y - ptr.uy, d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (d2 < 0.45) {
        const w = Math.exp(-d2 / 0.06) * ptr.k, d = Math.sqrt(d2) + 1e-4;
        p.vx += (ptr.vx * 0.6 - p.vx) * w * relax + dx / d * w * 0.55 * dt;
        p.vy += (ptr.vy * 0.6 - p.vy) * w * relax + dy / d * w * 0.55 * dt;
      }
    }
    p.x += ((n2 - n0) / e * turb + pull + p.vx) * dt;
    p.y += (-(n1 - n0) / e * turb + rise + p.vy) * dt;
    p.vx *= damp; p.vy *= damp;
  }
}
